## Futuristic Agent Command Center

The Windows Agent Manager now has a complete visual identity and a modern dark command-center interface.

### New design

- Original EITS monitoring shield icon with network and health-monitoring details.
- Branded executable, application window, system tray, shortcuts, and installer.
- Futuristic navy and cyan interface with clear live service-state indicators.
- Dedicated service core, secure uplink, latest telemetry, operations, and quick-access panels.
- Matching secure connection dialog for server and enrollment changes.

### Existing reliability fixes included

- Native Windows service creation and startup verification.
- Early ProgramData log creation.
- Recovery of incomplete enrollment attempts.
- Correct package version reporting.
